$comment: Single source of truth for what lives in this monorepo and what CI may run.
* Every top-level project directory MUST have exactly one entry here.
* A check is only ever set to `true` after it has been observed passing.
Flipping a flag optimistically is how a repository ends up with red
* Every `false` carries a `notes` string explaining the blocker.

projects.notes: No lint or test script defined.
Has a lint script; not yet verified clean, so it stays off.

Clean-architecture implementation with 42 unit tests. install, lint, build and test each observed passing from a clean checkout before these flags were set. ESLint runs on flat config; Cypress is not wired into CI and its binary download is skipped.
Declares pnpm@9.15.5 but installs cleanly with npm; unify on one package manager in a follow-up.

Angular CLI 22 requires Node >= 22.22.3, so this project pins Node 24. Build verified on Node 24 after pinning TypeScript to ~6 (compiler-cli peer range is >=6.0 <6.1), switching moduleResolution to bundler so Material's exports map resolves, completing the Tailwind v4 migration, and opting the five NgModule-declared components out of standalone.
Tailwind v4 via @tailwindcss/vite; the v3 theme is loaded through @config in src/layouts/global.css.
BLOCKED: arctic@3 no longer exports `Google` from the package root. src/lib/server/oauth.ts needs migrating to the current provider API before build can be enabled.
prebuild runs `prisma generate`, which needs no database. Prisma is on 7 with the pg driver adapter (ADR 0004); schema push and a live query were verified against a local Postgres 16.
React Native has no `build` script; producing an artifact needs the Android/iOS toolchains, which CI does not provision.
Frontend of the Flask app. The Python API alongside it is not yet covered by CI.
The Engineering Atlas. Nuxt 4 + Nuxt Content.
build runs tsc. A `typecheck` script is also available.

prebuild runs `prisma generate`, which needs no database. Prisma is on 7 with the better-sqlite3 driver adapter (ADR 0004). TypeScript is held at ^6 — the Nest CLI needs the programmatic compiler API that TS 7.0 removed.
No build script; the project runs from source via ts-node.

No build script; Bun runs TypeScript directly. Dependabot tracks it under the `bun` ecosystem so bun.lock is maintained alongside package.json — the `npm` ecosystem updated only the latter and broke `--frozen-lockfile`.
Single-file operational script; no build step.
Umbrella entry. The three Poetry projects beneath it — backend, frontend and pipelines — carry their own manifest entries and CI checks.
Streamlit UI. install runs `poetry check --lock` then `poetry install`; 6 tests pass. No build step and no linter configured.

Ingestion pipeline. install verified (~3.5 min; the torch/transformers tree is ~5.7 GB). test stays off: test_milvus_connector_collection_creation needs a live Milvus server, and test_markdown_processor fails with KeyError: 'title'. Both predate CI coverage.
FastAPI service. install verified (~3 min). test stays off because tests/test_app.py and tests/test_models.py are both empty files — pytest collects nothing and exits 5.
Flask API. Its own manifest entry is solid-flask-web-app/api; the frontend is covered separately as solid-flask-web-app/ui.

Flask API, pip + setuptools rather than Poetry. Python 3.13 to match Dockerfile.api. mysqlclient builds from source, so it needs MySQL client headers — declared in systemPackages. install, ruff and 75 tests all observed passing before these flags were set. No build step; the service runs from source.
No aggregator POM. discovery-server, api-gateway and patient-service have POMs; billing-service, clinical-service and scheduling-service ship sources without one.
